haiku.problem: Calls Job Eliphaz's "friend," which isn't in the Job 15 verses. The trivia rule allows only facts from the passage's verses. The phrase "one part of Job's own body, not Eliphaz, condemned him" is also awkward and could be misread.

Calls Job "Job's friend" (not in the verses). It also says Eliphaz "said" Job's heart had carried him away, but the verse is Eliphaz asking why Job's heart has carried him away, so the wording misstates it.
